roll_call.no_active_manager_body: This academy has no active manager. Nobody inside it can invite members, enroll students, or approve applications.
roll_call.awaiting_first_manager_body: The academy is ready. It opens when the manager accepts.
roll_call.suspended_body: Nobody can sign in to this academy.
roll_call.title: Needs you
roll_call.description: Academies that cannot run themselves right now.

empty.title: No academies yet
empty.body: Create the first one, and invite the manager who will run it.

create.title: New academy
create.subtitle: Create the academy, then hand it to its manager.
create.name_hint: What its members will call it.
create.slug_hint: Used in links. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
create.time_zone_hint: Sets the academy's day boundary. Every report and deadline is measured against it.
create.manager_email_hint: They receive an invitation and become the academy's manager when they accept.
create.contact_email_hint: How Cove reaches this academy. Not shown to students.
create.created_body: The invitation is on its way to {{email}}. The academy opens when they accept.
create.onboarding_legend: How will this academy get its first manager?
create.onboarding_open_body: The academy appears on the sign-up page straight away. Whoever signs up choosing it waits for you in Applications, and you decide their role.
create.onboarding_invite_body: They get a link that makes them a manager. You can copy the link here if the email does not arrive.
create.created_open_body: Nothing was sent. This academy is now on the sign-up page.
create.created_open_next: Whoever signs up choosing it waits in Applications. Approve one of them as manager to hand the academy over — or invite a manager by email from the academy page.
create.preview_address_empty: Set a name to see the link
create.preview_handover_open: Whoever signs up, once you approve them

detail.people_empty: Members appear here once the manager starts inviting them.
detail.resend_body: Sends a new invitation and cancels the old one. Change the address if the first was wrong.
detail.lifecycle_suspended: This academy is suspended. Nobody can sign in.
detail.lifecycle_archived: This academy is archived. It cannot be reopened.
detail.reason_hint: Recorded in the audit trail. Say why, for whoever reads this next.
detail.confirm_suspend_body: Everyone is signed out and nobody can sign in until you restore it. Live lessons end immediately.
detail.confirm_restore_body: Members can sign in again straight away.
detail.confirm_archive_body: This is permanent. An archived academy cannot be reopened.
detail.invite_body: Sends a link that makes this person a manager. You can copy the link here if the email does not arrive.

invite_link.notice: Copy this link now — it is shown only once.
invite_link.label: Invitation link

unavailable.title: Academies are unavailable
unavailable.body: The platform could not be reached. Try again shortly.
unavailable.forbidden_body: Your account does not have platform access.

identity.title: Name and address
identity.description: What this academy is called, and the slug it is reached at. Everything else belongs to its manager.
identity.name: Academy name
identity.slug_warning: Links using the old slug will redirect here rather than break.
identity.archived: An archived academy cannot be edited.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This cannot be undone. There is no archive to restore from and no backup this console can reach.
delete.stakes: Everything {{name}} owns goes: {{people}} accounts lose their membership, and every class, course, problem and submission is destroyed. The audit trail of what was done here survives.

content_panel.courses_empty_body: Add a course to give this academy something to teach.
content_panel.classes_empty_body: Add a class to start enrolling students.

content_delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
content_delete.course_body: This removes the course and every module, lecture and problem in it. Refused if any student has submitted through it — hide it instead.
content_delete.class_body: This removes the class, its roster and its schedule. Refused if any student has submitted through it — archive it instead.
